editorial.why_saudi: Saudi cuisine is part of daily life—what people cook, eat together, and share. Food connects to family, seasons, and regional identity across the kingdom.
editorial.why_now: September brings cooler evenings; Saudis start thinking about hearty meals and traditional dishes as weather shifts.
editorial.angle: Everyday Saudi dishes people actually make at home—ingredients, shortcuts, regional differences—not fancy restaurant food.
editorial.share_reason: Audiences engage with food that feels familiar and useful. A relatable take on what's in the kitchen sparks conversation.
editorial.research_query: traditional Saudi Arabian home cooking recipes ingredients
